title: Saving water
info: Clean water is precious. People, crops, and animals all need it.
Small habits add up: a drip all day wastes much more than a quick rinse.

questions.q: While you brush your teeth, a good habit is to
options: turn the tap off until you rinse
leave the tap running the whole time
told to a grown-up so it can be fixed

questions.q: Trash dumped in a river can
options: make the water unsafe for people and fish

questions.q: Collecting rain in a barrel, where that is safe, can
options: replace drinking water with no care
water plants without using the tap

questions.q: Type one thing that needs clean water: people, crops, or animals.
